integrity: The full eight-vertex sign classification is backed by coefficient-wise rational polynomial identities and sign arguments. Small-step statements for all path sizes are analytic. Literature overlap was compared to inspected sources; historical uniqueness and independent validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unweighted path Laplacians and the completed two-stage fourth-order Gauss–Legendre step. Complete timestep positivity is classified for eight vertices only. It does not address irregular weights, other graph families, internal stages, or other Padé orders.
title: An exact disconnected positivity window on the eight-vertex heat path
